description: Microwave Imager (MWI) flight model FM2, RTTOV Metop-SG satellite id 2. The curves are the channel spectral response functions distributed by the EUMETSAT NWP SAF for the RTTOV radiative-transfer model, converted from frequency to wavelength; bands chNN follow the RTTOV channel order.

links.label: NWP SAF SRF page for RTTOV sensor metopsg_2_mwi
NWP SAF spectral response functions index

licence.terms: No terms of use are stated on the NWP SAF SRF pages or in the files. The NWP SAF SRF index lists sensors whose 'SRFs cannot be published due to licence restrictions' separately; this sensor's SRFs are published there.
licence.scope: EUMETSAT NWP SAF distribution of originator data (see notes). Hosted under Nill's 2026-10-26 'host everything' decision.

notes: NWP SAF README_SRF: 'Data obtained from EUMETSAT for the MWI instrument. This is the first flight model which is FM2. Date received: 05/08/2026 via SAG Source files contain the Frequency [Hz], Gain@ambient temp (dB) and were then converted to units of GHz, and SRF relative response. The notches at MWI-10V (ch18) and MWI-13V (ch21) are needed to reject in-band RFI from ADCS-4 and S-band transmitter respectively.' Zeros added just inside gaps between separate passbands. Pivots agree with the page's central frequencies within 1% except double-sideband channels, whose pivot lies between the sidebands. DetectorType energy is assumed.
